children.text: Mark Rober is an American engineer and youtuber who formerly worked at NASA in their Jet Propulsion laboratory for nine years. He spent seven of those years working on the Curiosity Mars Rover, and then worked in Apple’s Special Projects Group until 2020 to become a full time youtuber. He is known for his hilarious videos where he makes do it yourself gadgets and other projects that bring in aspects of both engineering and science in a fun way for all ages. His channel, started in 2011, features insane experiments such as glitter bombs for package thieves and obstacle courses for squirrels. He has amassed over 80 million subscribers throughout the course of his channel. In 2022, he launched CrunchLabs, a STEM subscription box company. Alongside Mr. Beast, he led the #TeamWater campaign which generated over 40 million dollars for clean water access. In 2026, Rober was named to TIME’s list of top creators.
